items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: Seemed like another drummer, his name was Freddie the Popa Jones Crump.

ctx.x: And by the way, a great woman trumpet player, her name was Valaida Snow (phomatic). She could sing, play the piano, play the violin, act, she was a genius. She was up there, in Denmark.
Seemed like another drummer, his name was Freddie the Popa Jones Crump. Now, he was, -- That old man is something else.
